SDN.note: Isali is linked to the civil registry system for payments; no record exchange with the ID system stated.
Contracts with 22 banks and government accounts at the central bank are stated; no licensing, switch or PAPSS role.

facts.fact: Sudan's finance ministry says its Isali e-collection system is integrated with the ASYCUDA customs procedures system.
Sudan's finance ministry says Council of Ministers decisions 149 and 150 require workers' entitlements to be paid through bank accounts, and that this has been put into effect.
Sudan's finance ministry says its Isali electronic collection and payment system has been in use since early 2024, with contracts signed with 22 banks.
Sudan's finance ministry says Isali is relied on to collect all public revenue fees approved in the state budget, and is integrated with the ASYCUDA customs system.
